name: Apple HomeKit
description: HomeKit accessory advertisements (HAP type 0x06) and GATT UUID names for the services browser.
notes: The library icon is the unpaired orange. Scan rows still tint grey when paired and orange when unpaired. Category and paired state come from the advertisement only. After connect, central/gatt_identity.lua labels the accessory from HAP services and does not claim a pairing state.
